mapper.insert: INSERT INTO followup (id, attempt_id, judgment_id, type, question, source, leak_check_passed, prompt_version, model_version, bank_question_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{followup.attemptId}, #{judgmentId}, #{followup.type}, #{followup.question}, #{followup.source}, #{followup.leakCheckPassed}, #{followup.promptVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{followup.modelVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{followup.bankQuestionId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM followup WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId}

SELECT b.id, b.question FROM followup_bank_question b WHERE b.type = #{type} AND b.active ORDER BY EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM followup f WHERE f.attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND f.bank_question_id = b.id), b.created_at, b.id LIMIT 1
